messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
the viscous friction force depends on relative velocity.
velocity is scaled by a damping coefficient that depends on fluid viscosity, body size, and shape.
shape and area set the damping torque.
torque should be included when the pendulum moves through a fluid and damping is appreciable.
appreciable damping means the physical pendulum model needs a velocity-proportional damping term.
term can be omitted only in the ideal undamped model.
